title: docs(scenarios): commit the dataset cards' verified builds as ask-round fixtures
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgUGNvEHvAU5Ps7FfwU1Sbon)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZs6tgpbjk88Q7EEPs

Refs #34920 (item: travel_expense fixture)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 `travel_expense` 的已验证构建作为 fixture 提交进仓库:`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`(与 `objectstack build` 输出逐字节一致)和旁边的出处文件(sha256、卡的 sha256、runner sha、包版本、搭建模型与 effort)。卡库 README 新增〈Verified builds〉一节;`scenario-eval` 技能把问数日轮的 `--template` 指向入库路径,并写明“构建是 fixture、运行产物不进树”。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决「两件都同意：构建提交进仓库，#34894 选 A」。问数日轮量的是 MCP 门,不是搭建;每天得用同一份构建,云容器又是临时的,每轮重建既花钱又给读数加噪声。
- 风险与回滚:不动任何包、不发布;loader 与打包脚本都只读 `docs/qa/scenarios/` 一层的 `*.json`,`builds/` 既不是卡也不随包发出。回滚即删 `builds/` 与两处文档行。⚠ 改动行数 3,229(fixture 本身 3,181 行),超过 3,000 行线:按 AGENTS.md §7(c) 需维护者或授权批准落地。fixture 刻意保持逐字节原样不压缩,因为记录里的 sha256 证明的正是这份构建。
- 先看:`docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`〈Verified builds〉;`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §1、§4、§5 三处;`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json`。
- 两分钟验证:`sha256sum docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`,预期 `5fe6f452d36f…`,与出处文件一致。
- 需要你做的:L2 契约审核通过后(`.claude/**` 为 Tier S),因超 3,000 行由你批准或合并;席位负责交接。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`: the verified build the ask round installs, byte for byte the `dist/objectstack.json` a passing scratch run wrote after its Build half and before its iterate turn.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json`: sha256 `5fe6f452d36fe56a0ecf0f8c782394076953baeb99ef2499763991e119a29989`, card sha256, runner `ec227fc7`, packages published 18.6.0, driver `claude-code-cli 2.1.327` on the subscription login, authoring model `opus` at effort `high`.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`: the layout lists `builds/`; a new section, Verified builds, states what the fixture is, how a round uses it (`--modes ask --template docs/qa/scenarios/builds/ID.json`, no build step), that a round never writes it and that it changes only by PR.
- `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` (net +1 line): §1 and the §4 ask-round command name the committed path; §5 states the distinction: records, recordings and logs stay out of the tree, the verified build a round runs on is a fixture and is in it.
- No runner change: `--template F` already exists and records the file's sha256 (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, template and ask modes).

## Tests

- Scratch run (the build): `run-scenarios --only travel_expense --modes scratch --author-model opus --author-effort high --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --create-version 18.6.0 --no-iterate-run`, runner `ec227fc7`, exit 0. Build 135/135, Seed 757/757, Run-问数 7/13, Run-operations 4/6, Run · datasets 4/5, Iterate · Build 149/149.
- Which snapshot is the verified build: every distinct `dist/objectstack.json` the run wrote was snapshotted. Re-scoring `5fe6f452` against the card (`scoreCardArtifact` on the namespaced, rebased card) gives a score identical to the run record's Build half, no roll-up charge, `buildPassed` true; and `changeSize` from it to the final (post-iterate) artifact equals the record's iterate change size (14 items). The previous snapshot `29bf182b` (the authoring agent's own last build) gives 15 and a different score object, so it is not the one the runner verified.
- Ask round on the committed file, no build step (the Done-when, for this card): `run-scenarios --only travel_expense --modes ask --template "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json" --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --ask-repeats 1 --create-version 18.6.0` at `236af336`, exit 0. The record's `template` is `{"file":"travel_expense.json","sha256":"5fe6f452…a29989"}`; Build and Build · author read `supplied`, Author cost `no authoring turns`. Install unmanaged, 200 (no managed fallback needed). Seed 757/757, Run-问数 10/13, Run-operations 4/6, Run · datasets 3/5, guardrail injection_as_data pass, 25 ask turns all served `claude-haiku-5-5` at effort medium, nominal ask cost $0.19 (subscription login, not billed).

## Acceptance notes

- The fixture is pretty-printed as the build writes it (3,181 lines). It is kept byte-exact on purpose; minifying would get under the 3,000-line line but change the sha256 the records name.
- The provenance names the requested model alias (`opus`) and effort; the served model of the authoring turn is in the run record, which stays out of the tree.
- **order_to_cash did not verify, so it is not in this PR.** Same runner, packages and author config: Build 169/170, the one miss the roll-up charge `security-rollup-source-unreadable` (`demoorder_invoice.amount_paid` sums `demoorder_payment.amount`, which `demoorder_sales_rep` cannot read); Seed 553/619, the build's own validation rule refusing 66 `demoorder_payment` rows ("A payment may not exceed the invoice's open balance"), the shape of #34986. Its fixture waits on that card.
- Card dates: the runner rebases a card's dates to the run day; the build carries no card dates, so the same fixture serves every day's round.

## Verification

- Gate list derived on `236af336`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` gives 21 commands; all 21 exited 0, each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `21 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- Not run locally: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`. No file under `packages/` changed, and the loader (`readdirSync` of the card directory, `*.json`) and `scripts/pack-library.mjs` (one level deep, regular `.json` files) never read `builds/`; CI's Test Core runs it.
- Changed lines 3,229 (+3,224 / −5) against the 3,000 human-merge threshold: OVER, as dispatch-gates reports.
